## Identifying Perils and Hazards

| Situation                                                                          | Peril                | Hazard                         |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| A warehouse catches fire because of faulty wiring.                                 |                      |                                      |
| A policyholder deliberately burns an insured building to receive compensation.     |                      |                                      |
| A driver leaves a car unlocked because it is fully insured, and the car is stolen. |                      |                                      |
| Heavy rainfall causes a river to overflow and damage nearby houses.                |                      |                                      |

## Analysing the Components of Risk

| Component       | Description                                       |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| **Peril**       |                                                   |
| **Hazard**      |                                                   |
| **Frequency**   | Flooding is expected once every 10 years          |
| **Severity**    | Each flood may cause substantial damage to the property |
| **Uncertainty** |                                                   |
